subject.title: Tool call observability: input sanitization, error categorization, and context writeback

question: Should OpenClaw make this a narrow core metadata-only tool observability/writeback contract, fold it into the newer audit-ledger work, or defer the remaining writeback tracking?
rationale: The remaining work changes public diagnostic/transcript semantics and could expose sensitive tool or memory data unless maintainers settle the privacy, compatibility, exporter, and durable-storage boundary first.

options.title: Define a narrow core contract
options.body: Create an additive metadata-only tool observability/writeback schema with explicit redaction, low-cardinality exporter mapping, and focused follow-up PRs.

options.title: Fold into the audit ledger
options.body: Treat the newer metadata-only audit-ledger issue as canonical only if it explicitly covers tool inputs, errors, and writeback provenance for this request.

options.title: Defer writeback tracking
options.body: Keep the existing tool execution diagnostics and close or narrow this request until writeback auditing has a stronger product owner.

recommendation.title: Define a narrow core contract
recommendation.body: Create an additive metadata-only tool observability/writeback schema with explicit redaction, low-cardinality exporter mapping, and focused follow-up PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the related metadata-only audit issue and has adjacent state/lifecycle history that best matches the product decision boundary.
